title: Demon Hatching from Egg
description: A muscular horned demon with a glowing pink halo stands over a large cracked egg emitting bright pink light. Broken eggshell pieces lie on the ground surrounded by thorny vines, flowers, and a small ghost-like figure in a dark surreal scene.
prompt: A menacing muscular demon with horns and a glowing pink halo stands triumphantly over a large cracked stone egg that emits intense pink light from within. Broken eggshell fragments lie on dark green ground with thorny vines and flowers. A small ghost doodle floats near the plants. High contrast black background with white line art and vibrant pink accents, dark surreal fantasy style.
